annotations.title: Record the user's answer about a goal

description: Records the user's answer to the questions from cortex_create_goal, keyed by question id. `{"*":"skip"}` is the answer for a user who says to go ahead with whatever Mitosis thinks best. This is the last round: the reply carries answer_required=false and no further questions, because Mitosis asks about a goal once.

answers.description: Question id to the chosen option, or the user's own words. {"*":"skip"} takes the first option of each.

name: cortex_answer_goal
title: Record the user's answer about a goal
